svg.title: Luqman — Word Current
svg.desc: Word Current generated from all 546 written words in surah 31.
svg.metadata: {"surah":31,"name":"Luqman","method":"Word Current","words":546,"letters":2130,"selectedVerse":null,"mapping":"s=10*length; delta=(3*pi/4)*tanh((length-globalMean)/globalSD); exact circular arcs in word order from (0,0), heading 0; zero SD gives straight lines","source":"https://api.quran.com/api/v4/quran/verses/uthmani","counting":"Unicode whitespace words; Unicode L letters except U+0640/U+06E5/U+06E6; no normalization"}
